plainText:
The following is a list of all of the English language home video releases of the first season of , Indigo League, in . DVD releases are for , releases are for , and all releases are .

In Region 2 releases, the episodes are ordered and separated according to standard seasons (in the same way as on Pokémon.com), rather than by Viz Media season (as seen in Region 1 releases).

==Single releases==
===VHS===
The Indigo League single releases were released by in the United Kingdom on VHS. Only the first 33 episodes of Indigo League have been released on VHS in the United Kingdom.

A folded paper insert was included with each cassette detailing how to join the Pokémon Collector Club, alongside a numbered cut out token that could be sent away in exchange for a selection of different gifts. A coupon was also included for £1 off the next purchase of a Pokémon VHS at participating retailers.

 

"The Great Race" was released in a box set with the special episode Mewtwo Returns. The two VHS tapes have their own cases.

===DVD===
 
A single release DVD containing Indigo League episodes titled Partner Up with Pikachu! was released by in the United Kingdom on DVD on April 15, 2019. The episodes focus on the friendship between Ash and .
 

==Double releases==
 
Pokémon Volumes 5 & 6: Thunder Shock! / Seaside Pikachu is a dual VHS set that was released in the United Kingdom by on October 1, 2001 with the catalogue number S037417. It consists of two VHS tapes in a single case.
 
==Season 1 disc set==
 
 
 
The Season 1 disc set was released on DVD and Blu-ray by in the United Kingdom on October 30, 2017. Both sets contain a total of 52 episodes. The DVD set contains eight discs across 2 volumes, while the Blu-ray set contains five discs in one volume. Its discs are designed to resemble a . The set doesn't include English closed captioning.

===Contents===
Each disc features artwork of a specific Pokémon on the disc itself.
